title: V-FAT: Benchmarking Visual Fidelity Against Text-bias
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (V-FAT) specifically designed to measure the conflict between visual grounding and linguistic priors (text bias) in Multimodal Large Language Models. While it touches on 'sycophancy' as an alignment issue and includes 'social' as a reasoning category, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as defined.
